rules.statement: The substantial purpose of a deed conveying immovable property is not to create a charitable trust if it requires the transferees to provide alms givings annually as an obligation attached to ownership.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a deed conveying certain immovable property required the transferees to provide three alms givings annually- Held, that the substantial purpose of the deed was not to create a charitable trust but to convey title to the property subject to the condition that the alms givings should be provided as an obligation attached to the ownership.
